summary: PIMCO Asset-Based Lending Co LLC filed a Form 8-K reporting the liquidation, wind-up and dissolution of Series I (Series I Dissolution) and related amendments to its operating agreement and indemnification agreements. The Certificate of Cancellation for Series I was filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, effective June 15, 2026. No financial terms such as price, premium, or value were disclosed. The board took action to formally dissolve Series I and update governing documents. This is a structural restructuring event involving the dissolution of a series. Watch for any residual distributions or litigation regarding Series I dissolution.
